question: The financial year in India starts from 1st April and ends on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**31st March**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The financial year in India starts from **1st April** and ends on **31st March** of the following year.
 
• This period is used by the government and businesses for accounting and tax purposes.
